title: ID0445096-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2 / R3 312881977025] Outlet 2 - Cable check failing
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: Charge Point 2 Is Not Working
Solution: Most likely replace KF14 otherwise can be XD10.1 or contactor not closing properly.
Notes: DC2 fails sometimes during cable check, no errors flags visible, might be a vehicle issue.

additional_info.subject: ID0445096-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2 / R3 312881977025] Outlet 2 - Cable check failing CRM:02699000196
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex! Good morning :) How are you? I'm changing the title to reflect better the issue.
I checked this charger and here is what I found, I will share as much knowledge as I can:
From bottom to top, you can see we go to CableCheck -> C state -> Close contactor, but we are not seeing the contactor being closed properly.
Usually when we see the AbNormal it means that either the contactor didn't close physically or the StateMonitor is not able to close it.
From my experience, this is related to the StateMonitor because when the StateMonitor is able to close it, we still see some voltages in the logs and only after it finishes processing it fails. But here is almost immediately.
Please check the following:
Check if the XD10.1B is inserted properly as these connectors get loose often.
Since I'm almost 100% sure this is StateMonitor error, please trial replacing the KF13
If it doesn't work with the replacement please measure the following:
Measure 24V outputing from the KF14 and between the C1-C2 of both QA21-22.
If we have 24V in C1-C2:
Measure in the busbar if the contactors are really closing.
Measure the 13-14 to understand if the problem is from the feedback itself (I see the error while in single charging only so I believe this is excluded)
I recommend you to bring spare KF14 and QA21-22.
I will send this to the RC-CH queue. If you need on-site support please arrange with at least 2 days in advance as we are currently facing a surge of tickets.
Thank you!
BEstre
